_comment: The recorded pinned-build baseline arm for the ship.review empty-slot invariant (WF-347). Produced via WF-345's pinned-build install option: the pre-slot ship build installed as the run source. CANNED per item.md's disclosure — Docker + CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN are unavailable in this environment; the run bytes are shaped exactly like the WF-345 runner's output tree, and runner/run-skill.sh regenerates them from the real pinned build when a container and token are available.
